node: HVDC reactors, high-voltage reactive power compensation, capacitors, bushings, magnet wire, and specialized grid-stability equipment
summary: Layer 1B expansion found one direct underfollowed U.S.-listed grid-stability platform, one underfollowed transmission-hardware supplier, and two reference anchors. AMSC is the cleanest U.S.-listed small/mid-cap match for reactive power and voltage-stability equipment through D-VAR, actiVAR and related grid products. PLPC is less directly tied to HVDC/reactive compensation but is a highly relevant second-order transmission hardware beneficiary. HUBB and GEV are larger reference names: HUBB provides diversified utility T&D components including bushings/connectors/insulators and grid devices, while GEV is a direct global HVDC/FACTS/reactive compensation leader but too large and well-followed for the discovery lane.
